title: The coordinate covector e_j ⌟ det on ℝ^{m+1} and its values on the basis with one vector removed
statement: For every m ∈ ℕ and j ∈ Fin (m+1) there is a continuous alternating m-linear form β on ℝ^{m+1} (β ∈ Covector (Euclid (m+1)) m) such that, for every i ∈ Fin (m+1), β evaluated on the standard basis family (e₀, …, e_m) of ℝ^{m+1} with e_i removed (Fin.removeNth i) equals (−1)^j if i = j and 0 if i ≠ j. (Concretely β = e_j ⌟ δ, the interior product of e_j with the standard determinant form δ of ℝ^{m+1}.)
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), ∃ β : Covector (Euclid (m + 1)) m, ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), β (i.removeNth (fun l : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) = if i = j then (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ) else 0
